description: Style LinkedIn posts with Unicode bold and italic text variants.

faqs.a: LinkedIn doesn't allow real rich text in posts, so this maps your letters to Unicode Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols that look bold or italic everywhere.
faqs.q: Why Unicode instead of real formatting?

faqs.a: Mostly yes on modern phones and browsers, but a few older devices show boxes for rare symbols. Bold sans is the safest choice for compatibility.
faqs.q: Will everyone see the styled text?

faqs.a: Screen readers may read styled letters oddly, so use styling for emphasis on short phrases, not entire posts.
No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

howto: Type or paste the text you want to style.
Pick a style: bold, italic, bold-italic, bold sans or italic sans.
Click the copy button under the style you like.
Paste it into your LinkedIn post — the styling travels with the characters.
title: LinkedIn Text Formatter
